courses.subject: LEB
courses.title: Foundations of Business Law and Ethics
courses.description: Restricted to non-McCombs School of Business majors. Not open to law students. Introduction to the legal problems confronting businesses in the global environment. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Legal Environment of Business 320F, 323, and 323H. Prerequisite: Forty-five semester hours of college coursework.
courses.prereqText: Forty-five semester hours of college coursework.
courses.restricted: Restricted to non-McCombs School of Business majors.

courses.subject: LEB
courses.title: Business Law and Ethics
courses.description: Restricted to students in the McCombs School of Business. An investigation of the role of law in society; introduction to legal reasoning, dispute resolution, judicial process, constitutional law, agency, torts, government regulations; business ethics; study of contracts. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Legal Environment of Business 320F, 323, 323H. Offered on the letter-grade basis only.
courses.restricted: Restricted to students in the McCombs School of Business.
courses.offering: Offered on the letter-grade basis only.

courses.subject: LEB
courses.title: Business Law and Ethics: Honors
courses.description: Restricted to students admitted to the McCombs School of Business Honors Program. An investigation of the role of law in society; introduction to legal reasoning, dispute resolution, judicial process, constitutional law, agency, torts, government regulations; business ethics; study of contracts. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Legal Environment of Business 320F, 323, 323H. Offered on the letter-grade basis only. Prerequisite: Senior standing, Accounting 312H, and credit or registration for Business Administration 324H.
courses.prereqText: Senior standing, Accounting 312H, and credit or registration for Business Administration 324H.

courses.subject: LEB
courses.title: Healthcare Law and Policy
courses.description: Introduces the legal and political environment in which the U.S. health care system operates. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Legal Environment of Business 334M and 370 (Topic: Healthcare Law and Policy) may not both be counted. Offered on the letter-grade basis only. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing.
courses.offering: Offered on the letter-grade basis only.

courses.subject: LEB
courses.title: Law of Business Organizations
courses.description: Restricted to students in a business major. Study of basic legal principles of business organizations and operations, including practical comparison and assessment of advantages and disadvantages of different types of organization. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Thirty semester hours of undergraduate coursework, or consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Thirty semester hours of undergraduate coursework, or consent of instructor.

courses.subject: LEB
courses.title: Real Estate Law
courses.description: An examination of law pertaining to estates and interests in land, conveyances and mortgages, brokers, easements, contracts, default and foreclosure. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Legal Environment of Business 363 and 170 (Topic 13), 270 (Topic 13), 370 (Topic 13) may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Thirty semester hours of undergraduate coursework.
courses.prereqText: Thirty semester hours of undergraduate coursework.

courses.subject: LEB
courses.title: Commercial Transactions
courses.description: Restricted to students in a business major. Applied business transactions, with emphasis on the Uniform Commercial Code; emphasis on bailments, sales of goods, commercial paper, bank-customer relationships, creditor security devices, and bankruptcy. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Thirty semester hours of undergraduate coursework, or consent of instructor.
